mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id AS productId, product_name AS productName, product_type AS productType, sku_id AS skuId, sku_attribute AS skuAttribute, sku_value AS skuValue, current_stock AS currentStock, min_stock AS minStock, sales, create_time AS createTime, last_update_time AS lastUpdateTime FROM inventory WHERE id = #{inventoryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET current_stock = #{newStock}, last_update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{inventoryId}
